column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: One PDF with name, team, the team reviewed, what teammates reviewed, and for BOTH reviews: PR link, link to the comments left, and a screenshot of those comments.
column6: Complete PDF. Links and screenshots present for both reviews.
column9: Missing some links or screenshots, or covers only one review.
column12: No PDF, or no links and no screenshots.

column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: At least 2 line-anchored comments plus 1 summary comment per PR, submitted as a Comment review. Approve and Request changes are not allowed on another team's PR.
column6: Both PRs have 2 or more line-anchored comments plus a summary, submitted as Comment.
column9: Only one PR got a proper review, or the second lacks line-anchored comments.
column12: Reviewed in the PDF but little or nothing left on the PR.
column15: Nothing posted on GitHub, or used Approve or Request changes.

column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: Each comment names a concrete thing in the code and says what could change.
column6: Comments point at specific code and propose a change the author can act on.
column9: Some comments specific; the rest generic.
column12: Comments are generic or cannot be acted on.

column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: Written answers for both PRs covering process, correctness and security (contract, ownership, auth and secrets, client states) and code quality, in complete sentences grounded in the code.
column6: Both PRs analyzed across process, correctness and code, grounded in the code.
column9: One PR only, or answers one-word or not grounded in the code.

column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: Each onboarding issue the student checked has a comment stating verified fixed, answered, or still blocks with output; links are in the PDF.
column6: Issues checked and commented with what was found.
column9: Claimed in the PDF but no comment on the issues, or comments without checking.

column1: P3 Cross-team Check-in 2: Code Review rev. FA26
column3: Who reviewed the student, what they said, and a concrete sentence starting With this feedback I will. If nobody did, a self-review of the student's latest PR stated as such.
column6: Records the feedback and commits to a specific change.
column9: No record and no self-review substitute, or the response amounts to no change.
